provenance.inclusion_rule: Taxon in {Prokaryote, Human, Eukaryote}; Virus excluded before analysis; assay retained only when a UniProt EMBL ProteinId CDS fetched from ENA translates under the standard nuclear code to a sequence containing the ProteinGym target_seq as an exact contiguous substring, yielding a fixed codon offset; only measured Leu/Arg/Ser sites with native codon agreeing with target amino acid are emitted.
provenance.generated_note: Frozen derived artifact. Experiment scripts must read this panel only; raw ProteinGym, UniProt, and ENA caches are intentionally not committed. Site intolerance I is negative mean within-assay z-scored DMS_score over parsed nonsynonymous single mutants at that site. Optimality o is RSCU(native codon) computed from the matched CDS for that assay gene: codon count divided by the mean count over synonymous codons in the standard-code amino-acid family.
